# Vendored frontend assets

- Bootstrap 5.3.8: compiled CSS and bundled JavaScript from the version-pinned jsDelivr URLs documented by Bootstrap.
- Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1: icon-font CSS and WOFF/WOFF2 files from the version-pinned distribution.

These files are served through Django static files so production rendering does not depend on a third-party CDN. Review upstream release notes and integrity values before upgrading.
